title: Token and foundation files hold values, not behaviour

facts.note: Design root is a directory named design, design_system or design-system; the first directory beneath it names the layer. Only tokens/foundations are in scope. Applies to every in-scope file, existing or newly written.
Derived from the first directory beneath the design root.
.css token files and *.test.* / *.spec.* files are not scanned; vendored/build directories are excluded.
Produced by the existing validator bun_design_system_detector, which scans token/foundation code files.

fires: A code file under <design root>/tokens/ imports a renderer such as hono/jsx, react, preact or @kitajs/html
A foundations code file returns or renders markup
A token code file computes a value with if/for/while/switch
An existing, unchanged token file already contains one of the above when the validator runs
doesNotFire: The repository has no design, design_system or design-system directory
A .css token file under the tokens layer
A *.test.* or *.spec.* file, or files in vendored/build directories
Files in the primitives, components or templates layers
A token file declaring only strings, numbers, objects of them, or var(--…) references

given: A code file in the `tokens` or `foundations` layer beneath a design root (`design`, `design_system`, `design-system`)
when: The file exists in the repository and the design-system validator scans it
then: The file contains only values (palette, spacing, radii, motion, scales) and does not import a renderer (`hono/jsx`, `react`, `preact`, `@kitajs/html`), render markup, or branch with `if`/`for`/`while`/`switch`.
prefer: Keep tokens/foundations value-only; move markup to primitives/components and behaviour to the layer that owns it
During GREEN: leave the value in the token or foundation file
During GREEN: move only the markup or logic the current behaviour requires to the nearest existing owning layer
During GREEN: reuse an existing primitive or component before creating a new one
avoid: Moving behaviour into a different layer merely to silence the rule
Creating a generalized component unrelated to the current acceptance
unless: Test files (`*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`) and vendored/build directories are never scanned
`.css` token files are values by construction and are not scanned
A repository with no design root is not judged (self-scoping)
why: Tokens are what every other layer depends on; once they render or decide, the bottom of the hierarchy has behaviour and every primitive inherits it.
evidence: The current behavioral or rendering acceptance passes
Token and foundation code files remain value-only: the detector reports no renderer imports, rendered markup or control flow in them
verifier_detail: Design root: a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system`; the first directory beneath it names the layer: `tokens` or `foundations`, `primitives`, `components`, `templates`. A repository with no design root is not judged (self-scoping): there is no system to connect to yet.
pure_token: a declaration whose value is data — a string, number, or object of them, including `var(--…)` references.
Detector scans token/foundation code files for renderer imports (`hono/jsx`, `react`, `preact`, `@kitajs/html`), rendered markup, and control flow (`if`/`for`/`while`/`switch`).
Skip `*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`, vendored/build directories, and `.css` token files.
audit: Bun realization of `coder.design.foundations` (the bottom of the hierarchy is pure), mirroring `coder.vite.design-tokens-pure`.
fix_hint headings: 'Canonical path:', 'During GREEN:', 'Do not broaden:', 'Prove:'

sharedNodes.text: During GREEN, change only what the current behaviour requires. Do not broaden: no unrelated reorganization, nothing unrelated to the current acceptance. Prove: the current behavioral (or rendering) acceptance passes.

trace.note: 'During GREEN:' qualifier is carried on each GREEN prefer item
